column2: [intro]
In this world where everything’s gray,
We add some color and it lights the way.
Criticism just makes us laugh,
We move on without a second thought to craft.
We rarely face negative remarks,
For we keep a spirit bright and stark.
Let’s leave the criticism far behind,
We’re here to enjoy life, unwind!
We refuse to let it bring us down,
Criticism slides off, it won’t make us frown.
Every day, we write our own tale,
And erase the negativity without fail.
With our positive energy we thrive,
Like a glowing firefly, we come alive.
Negative comments take a detour,
Our joy is our only allure!
[ solo ]
